## Motivation

What problem does this feature solve, or what is the use case? If a related issue or [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/dzianisv/opencode-mobile/discussions) already exists, link it here.

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you would like and how you expect it to work.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you have thought of, and why the proposed solution is better.

## Willing to contribute?

- [ ] I am willing to open a pull request for this.
